name: temporary_and_pair_gadget_substitution
precondition: family dv_recon; Toffoli-level op list over x / cx / cz / z / h / ccx / ccz only (no rz, no off-grid rotation, no pre-existing measurement), containing at least one ccz or ccx, 6 <= qubits <= 34, ancilla_room not required (the gadget reuses the wire that the Toffoli already writes). A circuit with no ccz/ccx, or in which no ccz/ccx target can be certified |0> immediately before it, is excluded by the declared precondition and costs nothing.
identity: LOCAL, per-Toffoli substitution of Gidney's temporary AND - no whole-circuit semantic recognition, which is what distinguishes it from attempt 1's global adder resynthesis. Step 0 (normalisation only, no cost change): a pattern h(t) ; ccz(a,b,t) ; h(t) with no other gate touching t between the h's is rewritten to ccx(a,b -> t); this is an exact identity because H Z H = X on the controlled branch. Step 1 (compute): if the target t of a ccx(a,b -> t) is certified to be in |0> immediately before it, replace that ccx by and_compute(a,b -> t), Gidney's 4-T temporary-AND gadget (4 T, 0 extra qubits, t holds a AND b exactly). Cost 7 T -> 4 T. Step 2 (uncompute, the large half): if additionally there is a LATER ccx(a,b -> t) on the SAME ordered wire triple such that between the two occurrences t is touched only as a CONTROL of cx/cz/ccz (never a target, never under h, never measured), replace that later ccx by and_uncompute(t): measure t in the X basis and apply the classically controlled cz(a,b) fix-up. Cost 7 T -> 0 T. A matched pair therefore goes 14 T -> 4 T, a saving of 10 T per pair; an unpaired compute on a clean target goes 14 T -> ... 7 T -> 4 T, a saving of 3 T. Controls a,b are untouched by the rewrite, so the gadget is a strictly local window replacement and the rest of the op list is re-emitted verbatim.
correctness: Three parts. (1) Zero-certification of t: a conservative forward |0>-analysis over the op list - t is |0> at position p if, on every gate before p that touches t, either t is untouched, or t is the target of a cx/ccx whose controls are themselves certified |0>, or t was restored by an earlier and_uncompute / matched ccx pair. Only wires the analysis proves |0> are rewritten; anything unproven declines. This is the ONLY premise the rewrite needs, because CCX acting on a |0> target is exactly the AND map |a,b,0> -> |a,b,ab>, and and_compute implements precisely that map on a |0> target (Gidney 2018, Fig. 3: 4 T gates, exact, no approximation and no error budget). (2) The uncompute is exact branch-wise: between compute and uncompute, t appears only as a control of diagonal/classical gates, so the joint state is sum_x alpha_x |x> |ab(x)> with no superposition structure in t beyond the computed value; measuring t in the X basis yields outcome m in {+,-} with equal weight, the data is unchanged for m = +, and for m = - it differs by exactly the phase (-1)^{a b}, which the classically controlled cz(a,b) fix-up cancels identically. So K_m |x> = c_m |f(x)> with the same c_m = 1/sqrt(2) for every input x and sum_m |c_m|^2 = 1 - invariant 2 holds branch-wise, which is why the rule is exact, error_budget 0, and does not draw on the 5e-4 pool. (3) Judge-side: the compute half is a unitary Clifford+T window and is checked exactly over D[omega]; the measured half is checked by the relaxed-window branch agreement (both measurement branches must agree with the original ccx on the data wires with t returned to |0>), i.e. the rule never asserts its own correctness.
trigger: Fires once per certified Toffoli, scanning the op list in order. (1) Normalise h-ccz-h sandwiches to ccx (and record the inverse so untouched ones are re-emitted unchanged). (2) Run the |0>-analysis above, producing the set Z of (position, target) pairs where the target is certified |0>. (3) For each such ccx at position i on (a,b -> t), search forward for the first ccx on the same ordered triple (a,b -> t) at position j > i, and check the between-window condition: no gate in (i, j) has t as a target, applies h to t, or measures t, and a and b are not written between i and j (if either control is written, decline that pair - the fix-up cz(a,b) would act on the wrong parity). If all hold, emit one match {i, j, a, b, t} for the pair; if no partner exists, emit a compute-only match {i, a, b, t}. (4) Matches are disjoint by construction (a position belongs to at most one match, taken greedily in index order), so apply() is pure and deterministic. Decline if Z is empty, if the rewritten circuit does not price strictly lower, or if any emitted window fails the judge.
expected_effect: adder_8 is a lookahead-style adder on 24 wires with 16 data bits, so ~8 wires are tree ancillas that are written by a ccz/ccx, consumed only as controls further up the carry tree, and then uncomputed by the mirror-image ccz/ccx on the same triple - which is exactly this trigger's shape, and is also why the gate trigrams are dominated by ccz-h-h / h-h-ccz blocks (the h pairs that make each ccz a ccx on its ancilla target). I expect ~16 of the 57 ccz to normalise into matched compute/uncompute pairs on certified-|0> ancillas (16 ccz -> 8 pairs, 8 x 10 = 80 T) and a further ~10 ccz to be compute-only writes onto clean ancillas (10 x 3 = 30 T), with the remaining ccz (targets on data wires, not certifiable |0>) left untouched at 7 T each. Estimated 399 T -> ~250-290 T. Qubit count does NOT grow (the gadget writes into the wire the Toffoli already targeted); CNOT count rises slightly and depth is unchanged in order. This is not a repeat: it touches no rotation (rotation_count and angle_cost have zero headroom here and the circuit has 0 rotations), it is not pyzx-class gadget fusion, and unlike attempt 1 it never needs to recognise the circuit as an adder or discard the lookahead tree - it is a window-local gadget swap, so a mis-recognition is impossible and the uncompute savings are available even if only a few ancillas certify. It is also strictly orthogonal to pyzx's 173, which is unitary and cannot use measurement at all.
source: Craig Gidney, 'Halving the cost of quantum addition', Quantum 2, 74 (2018) - the temporary AND gadget (4 T compute, measurement-based 0-T uncompute with a classically controlled CZ fix-up); Jones, 'Low-overhead constructions for the fault-tolerant Toffoli gate', PRA 87, 022328 (2013) - measurement-assisted Toffoli with feed-forward correction; Draper, Kutin, Rains, Svore, quant-ph/0406142 - the carry-lookahead structure whose compute/uncompute ancilla pairs this trigger matches.
